To join, post an umber ledger of 7 time-locked receipts, each a 32-byte hash of a unique 90-second job spaced 11-14 minutes apart, gossiped into a nebula of 9 auditors from 3 meadow regions. Cost: 95 POA bond plus 0.25 POA per receipt; 30 clones need 2850 POA and 210 jobs. Checks: 11-14 min gaps, no hash collisions, 3 meadow regions, 7 unique jobs. If 2 receipts share a start-second or 12-bit hash prefix, slash 70% of the bond and cool 6 epochs; fewer than 5 auditor acks in 25 minutes expires the bid and keeps an 8 POA fee.
